Este mecanismo —cada elemento hace lo mi: This mechanism —every element doing the same thing with a lag— is how things coordinate without coordinating. John Whitney llevaba haciendo esto sin o: John Whitney had been doing this without a computer since the 1950s. He built a machine out of parts from a Second World War anti-aircraft analogue gun computer, and with it he filmed points turning at slightly different speeds: as they went out of phase, they drew figures nobody had traced. His son made the computer sequence of 2001: A Space Odyssey with that technique. Whitney called his work digital harmony, and held that the relations that make a moving image beautiful are the same ones that make a chord consonant. In this topic you are doing the same thing he did, with a graphics card instead of a war engine.
